prompt: Write a user story for enabling dark mode in the application's settings screen.

check.rubric: Uses a specific role (e.g. a user who works at night / prefers low-light). Follows the story template with genuine value. 2-5 testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria covering toggling dark mode and persistence of the choice. Small and testable; nothing invented beyond a dark-mode setting.

prompt: Requirement: the checkout page must show an estimated delivery date before the customer pays. Write the user story with testable acceptance criteria.

check.rubric: Uses the specific role 'customer' at checkout. Follows the template with clear value (informed purchase decision). Testable Given/When/Then acceptance criteria covering the estimated delivery date being visible before payment. Testable and in-scope; nothing invented beyond showing an estimated delivery date pre-payment.
